title: Music and Arts
writing_topic: Write an informal letter/email of about 70 words to invite a friend to the Street Painting Festival.
grammar_focus: Comparisons: like, different from, (not) as ... as. Structures: N1 + is like/different from + N2; N1 + is (not) as + Adj + as + N2. Invitations: Would you like to go to...? How about going to...? Let's meet at... Event details: The show starts at [Time] at [Place].
sentence_guide: 1. Compare art forms: N1 + is like/different from + N2; N1 + is (not) as + adjective + as + N2. 2. Make an invitation: Would you like to go to...? / How about going to...? / Let's meet at... 3. Give the time and place: The show starts at [Time] at [Place]. Remember to use different from, not different with; use V-ing after How about and to + V after Would you like.

ordering_exercises.question: as / painting / interesting / is / photography / not / as /.
ordering_exercises.answer: Painting is not as interesting as photography. (Or: Photography is not as interesting as painting.)

ordering_exercises.question: about / water puppet show / going / to / how / a / tonight / ?
ordering_exercises.answer: How about going to a water puppet show tonight?

ordering_exercises.question: different / my / art taste / from / is / yours /.
ordering_exercises.answer: Our tastes in art are different.

completion_exercises.question: The new art gallery / be / different / the old museum.
completion_exercises.answer: The new art gallery is different from the old museum.

completion_exercises.question: Let us / meet / front of / the theater / 7:30 p.m.
completion_exercises.answer: Let's meet in front of the theater at 7:30 p.m.

completion_exercises.question: Would you / like / see / concert / with / me / this Sunday?
completion_exercises.answer: Would you like to see a concert with me this Sunday?

writing_prompt: Write an informal letter/email of about 70 words to invite a friend to the Street Painting Festival.
outline: 1. Opening: Greet your friend and invite them to an art or music event. 2. Main content: Give the festival time and location; describe street painting activities and explain why joining will be interesting. 3. Meeting and closing: Suggest a meeting time and place, then say that you hope your friend can come and look forward to their reply.
sample_basic: Hi Mai, Would you like to join the Street Painting Festival with me this Sunday? It starts at 8 a.m. in the town square. We can watch students make colourful pictures on the street and enjoy the music. I think it will be fun. Let's meet at the bus stop at 7:45 a.m. Please tell me if you can come. Bye, Lan.
sample_intermediate: Hi Mai, How about taking part in the Street Painting Festival this Saturday? It will be held in the town square from 8 a.m. to 11 a.m. Many students will draw colourful pictures on the street. We can work together and enjoy the festival atmosphere. Let's meet in front of the library at 7:45 a.m. I hope you can come. See you, Lan.
sample_advanced: Dear Mai, There is a Street Painting Festival in our town this Sunday morning. Would you like to join me? The event will take place in the town square at 8 a.m. We can create a picture together, look at other students' artwork and have a great time. I think it will be an interesting way to enjoy art with our friends. Let's meet at the library at 7:45 a.m. Best, Lan.

rubric.score_0: Lạc đề hoặc không đúng dạng bài.
rubric.score_1: Đúng chủ đề nhưng thiếu một số yêu cầu.
rubric.score_2: Đúng chủ đề và đúng dạng bài theo yêu cầu.

rubric.score_1: Có một số ý phù hợp nhưng chưa đầy đủ.
rubric.score_2: Đủ các ý chính, có thông tin phù hợp.

rubric.score_1: Có một số lỗi nhưng vẫn hiểu được.
rubric.score_2: Dùng khá chính xác cấu trúc/ngữ pháp trọng tâm.

rubric.score_0: Từ vựng sai hoặc rất hạn chế.
rubric.score_1: Dùng được từ cơ bản, còn lặp.
rubric.score_2: Dùng đúng từ vựng theo chủ đề.

rubric.score_0: Bài thiếu mạch lạc, nhiều lỗi.
rubric.score_1: Có trình tự tương đối rõ, còn vài lỗi.
rubric.score_2: Bố cục rõ, liên kết hợp lý, ít hoặc không có lỗi.

common_errors:
1. Dùng sai giới từ trong cấu trúc so sánh khác với. Sai: Pop music is different with classical music. Đúng: Pop music is different from classical music.
2. Nhầm dạng động từ sau các mẫu câu mời. Sai: How about go to the show? / Would you like go with me? Đúng: How about going to the show? / Would you like to go with me?
